/clan create <tag> [description] - Create a clan with the name <tag>
/clan join <tag> - Join clan <tag> which you have been invited to
/clan reject <tag> - Reject an invite to clan <tag>
ClanHelpAdmin: View ADMINISTRATIVE commands by opening F1 console and typing clans.help
ClanHelpDefault:
Available commands:
/clan - Display your clan information
/clan home - Teleport to your clan's home
/clan leave - Leave your clan
ClanHelpModerator:
Moderator commands:
/clan ff - Toggle friendly fire status
/clan aff - Toggle allied friendly fire
/clan invite <partialNameOrId> - Invite a player
/clan withdraw <partialNameOrId> - Cancel an invite
/clan kick <partialNameOrId> - Kick a member
/clan sethome - Set your clan's home
ClanHelpOwner:
Owner commands:
/clan ally <tag> - Ally another clan
/clan description <text> - Set the clan description
/clan promote <partialNameOrId> - Promote a member
/clan owner <partialNameOrId> - Set a new owner of the clan
/clan demote <partialNameOrId> - Demote a member
/clan disband - Disband your clan (you cannot undo this action)
/clan resetally [tag] - Remove an alliance
/clan withdrawally <tag> - Withdraw your ally invitation from another clan
